purpose: I need something in writing with my roommate because stuff keeps getting weird. We split rent and utilities, but she’s late a lot, her boyfriend is over constantly, and we keep arguing about dishes, noise, and whose stuff is taking over the living room. I might move out later this summer, but for now I want something fair that says what we each owe, quiet hours on weeknights, some limit on overnight guests unless we both agree, and that shared spaces need to stay reasonably clean. Make it clear, practical, and not overly harsh.
title: Agreement
